def _parse_to_end(inline: 'InlineParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'InlineState', tok_type: str, end_pattern: Pattern[str]) ->Optional[int]:
    pos = m.end()
    src = state.src[pos:]

    if not end_m:
        return None

    new_state.src = text
    children = inline.render(new_state)

        'type': tok_type,

def _parse_to_end(inline: 'InlineParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'InlineState', tok_type: str, end_pattern: Pattern[str]) ->Optional[int]:
    pos = m.end()
    src = state.src[pos:]
    end_m = end_pattern.search(src)
    if not end_m:
        return None
    # The end pattern matches (last_content_char)(closing_delimiter)
    # We want text to include up to and including the last content char
    # but not the closing delimiter (e.g., ~~, ==, ^^)
    # The closing delimiter is 2 chars long
    end_pos = end_m.end()
    text = src[:end_pos - 2]  # exclude the closing delimiter (2 chars)
    new_state = state.copy()
    new_state.src = text
    children = inline.render(new_state)
    state.append_token({
        'type': tok_type,
        'children': children
    })
    return pos + end_pos
